11 Field judgment / scenario work

See the risk.
Shape the response.

01
Field judgment

Work at height

Fall exposure changes quickly with access, edges, openings and task movement.

  • Plan access and working platform
  • Protect edges and openings
  • Inspect fall-protection equipment
02
Field judgment

Lifting operations

Loads, equipment, people and communication must remain controlled as one system.

  • Confirm lifting plan and equipment condition
  • Establish exclusion zones
  • Maintain clear signaling and supervision
03
Field judgment

Excavation safety

Ground conditions, buried services, access and collapse risk require continuous review.

  • Identify services and ground conditions
  • Protect edges and provide safe access
  • Inspect after change or adverse conditions
04
Field judgment

Confined space

Restricted access, atmosphere and rescue readiness make preparation essential.

  • Test and monitor the atmosphere
  • Control entry and communication
  • Prepare rescue before entry
